instruction: The project has six exterior walls, all using the same asymmetric exterior wall type whose render and insulation layers must face OUTSIDE. Some of them are mounted reversed. Find out which walls are flipped and turn them around so every outer layer faces outdoors. Keep all wall positions unchanged and do not touch the correctly oriented walls.
